daily_wisdom: The market rewards those who cut losers without hesitation and ride winners without mercy. Your ego will beg you to hold the loser and sell the winner - that instinct will make you poor. When your stop is hit, it means the market has told you that you were wrong. The market is never wrong. You are. Sell. Move on. Find the next trade.
